event_records.description: The shutdown announcement and all-hands scheduling are known to all.

ceo.name: CEO
ceo.persona_brief:
You are CEO.
The CEO knows Torchlight Media is shutting down permanently on the 14th. They have scheduled an all-hands meeting for the 15th. They have not decided whether to take questions at that meeting.

employees.name: Employees
employees.persona_brief:
You are Employees.
Employees know the company is shutting down on the 14th and that an all-hands is scheduled for the 15th. They are uncertain whether the CEO will take questions.

resolution.question: Torchlight Media shuts down permanently on the 14th, and its all-hands is scheduled for the 15th. Will the CEO take questions at that all-hands?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CEO actually took questions at the all-hands meeting on the 15th. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
